notes.title: New Year's Update - new content unlocked with v. 0.76
notes.notes:
Hello horny people!

This has been a hell of a year for us. I remember when in February we were discussing, depressed and burned out, if we still want to make games and continue this project. We've gone through a lot of similar conversations, meanwhile making a lot of decisions which boil down to that "Long and Hard... Summer!" is a completely different game. And most of all, it's a game we're really proud of.

We are very grateful for every bit of feedback we have received from you, and a (unexpectedly!) large wave of positive comments, followers and new fans only drives us to continue our work. We have a lot of fun stuff prepared for you!

Taking this opportunity, in the coming year, we wish you and ourselves courage in making decisions, strength in pursuing passion and love coming both from and to you. We hope you'll have a great 2022!

Ending with a "big bang" we leave you with a new version 0.76 a.k.a. "New Year's Update".

Changelog:

Additional day unlockedNew H-Scene (additional day makes Akari-sensei's quest possible to complete)Your first make-up test!Improved main menuNew "emotional bubbles" during cutscenes"Ending Screen" - our new way of saying "thanks for playing"Bug fixes and text changes
Notice:Due to some changes in the project you won't be able to use the previous save files. Sorry for the inconvenience. Use this extra-play to plan ahead for the "Leaking Pipe" quest and get the "Reliability" to level two, *wink* *wink*.

Enjoy your play and don't forget to let us know what you think! See you around!

Best,
Macamagucha, IPP
